text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Soaking in the sun while lounging in the dorm—
Man, this really hits the spot.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alrighty then. For my chill afternoon break,
guess I'll brew some tea and take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: N-N-N-N-Natureee~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Huh? What's up, Machi?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I-Inside the hat I just bought,
a spider is chilling out...!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Please lend me a hand so we can somehow, peacefully ask it to leave~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah~ gotcha.
Good grief, can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well now, crisis averted.
Time for that tea—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: N-Natureee!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...D-Déjà vu?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
M-My room is completely flooded
with super spicy sauce! Help mee~!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
My precious analysis notes have vanished!
Do you have any idea where they might be!?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Hear me!
My heartfelt serenade!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Aagh, alright, alright! Already got it!
One at a time, people!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Phew. There really is no end to people's troubles in this world, is there?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
....... All clear to the right, all clear to the left.
No troubled souls in sight. Now then—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Nature-san.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? What is it this time!?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Here you go. I have brought some snack refreshments for you.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Oh, thanks.
...Refreshments?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You are constantly listening to everyone's consultations, Nature-san.
I thought this might help you take a well-deserved breather.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... well, yeah, but honestly
I don't think it's that big of a deal.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: I've kind of been in this position since I was a kid—or rather, for as long as I can remember.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I like listening to people talk.
Guess it's in my blood from my mom running a snack bar and all.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
If anything, when nobody comes to me with their troubles,
I almost feel a little lonely... Ahaha.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...I see.
So it serves as fuel for your energy instead.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ahaha. Maybe I should just turn this solarium into my own little diner~?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: "No alcohol served, but tea and meals are totally fine, and you can enjoy a nice casual chat with Nature-san~." ...Just kidding, though.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: ...I see, that is quite a sound idea.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
All riiiight!
I'm gonna dump tons of seasonings into the stew~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no, keeping the seasoning simple is plenty fine.
Instead, let it simmer slowly—

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, impressive!
The signature dish of "Nature's Heartfelt Diner" has been born~!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what!? It has!?
And what's this "Nature's Heartfelt Diner"!?
...How did it even come to this!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: One day, I caught the aroma of stew drifting from the Ritto dormitory, alongside a long queue extending outside.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: HOW DID IT EVEN COME TO THIS!?!?!?
